about: GBC-style Hoenn party icons on one sheet: 16x16 cells on a 17-pixel grid (1-pixel lines), ten Pokémon to a row in national order from Treecko, each Pokémon's first frame on one row and its second frame on the row under it. Colours are Crystal's party-menu scheme with the red swapped for a colour per Pokémon. (0,0,1) is drawn as black.
